headline.en: Tea-infused coffee in a garden setting

traits.zh: 门店含庭院与绿植造景，地面铺落叶
traits.en: Features a courtyard with leaf-covered ground and greenery

traits.zh: 整面临街玻璃窗，采光良好
traits.en: Full-floor street-facing glass windows with good natural light

traits.zh: 招牌饮品为桂花拿铁，融合中国茶文化
traits.en: Signature drink is osmanthus latte, blending Chinese tea culture

traits.zh: 提供手工焦糖南瓜重芝士蛋糕等西式甜点
traits.en: Offers handmade caramel pumpkin cheesecake and Western pastries

traits.zh: 营业时间覆盖早咖至晚间微醺，全天运营
traits.en: Operates all day from morning coffee to evening drinks

energy.zh: 庭院静谧但临街有客流
energy.en: Quiet garden with street-side foot traffic

focus.zh: 未见有人办公，非专注场所
focus.en: No visible work activity, not focused

adventure.zh: 使用碧螺春、龙井等茶咖创新
adventure.en: Experimental tea-based coffees like Longjing and Biluo Chun
